metadata.description: SFP, Skills for Productivity: 559 agent skills sorted by what you build, plus a hive that picks the few each task needs for your project and learns from feedback. Installs into 16 IDEs and CLIs, and serves any MCP client.

plugins.name: sfp
plugins.description: The router and the hive: find the right skill for any task, installed or not, and choose which few skills to use, in what order, for the task and the project, learning from feedback.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: UI design and components, motion, accessibility, UX research and critique, React, Vue, Next.js, Angular, Vite. Includes Impeccable, the Taste skills, Emil Kowalski's animation skills and the Vercel web interface guidelines.

plugins.name: design-styles
